$comment: nodes=modules, edges=[cause,effect] where cause is imported-by effect. Repo is pre-code, so nodes are seeded from the architecture chosen in G0 (see memory-system.html, sections L2/L9/2.1), not from a real import scan. Re-run graphizer.mjs once src/ exists to replace these with real edges.

invariants.no_cross_user_leakage: User A's memory must never be returned to user B — every memory_store query must be scoped by user_id (row-level security once multi-user).
invariants.deleted_never_retrieved: Deleted memories must never be retrieved by the retriever — deletes are hard filters, not soft flags left visible to ranking.
invariants.retrieval_optional: memory_store/retriever failure must never prevent response_llm from answering — degrade to no-memory context, never block the response (timeout + fallback).
invariants.provenance_required: Every record written by evaluator into memory_store must carry a source (conversation id, document, or human input) — no memory without provenance.

$comment_milestones: Node-to-milestone map (see PLAN.md / DONE.html): M1 extractor+evaluator+memory_store, M2 retriever+ranking+context_composer, M3 reliability+isolation cuts across memory_store/retriever, M4 metrics, M5 audit_log, M6 cost_tracking, M7 eval_gate, M8 corrections+forget, M9 reflection+conflict_resolution.
